name: Altera G21 frameset package

editorial.verdict: A broad-capability 53 mm 1× package with storage and modern standards, but its 433 mm chainstays, 79 mm BB drop and current size-56 weight make it an adventure-gravel choice rather than a road-like lightweight answer.
caveats: International/direct pricing is well above budget frames
The 53 mm maximum is explicitly 1×; the 2× tire maximum is unknown
Older and current official weight bases conflict and are preserved separately

purchase_route: Current Chinese-language Yoeleo direct storefront with worldwide shipping; mainland checkout, delivery, return terms and a CNY amount were not exposed.
